Expected build/archive bindings were reconciled after timing, not prechecked by the frozen runner.

qualificationHistory: Both production binaries built from the original runtime patch. Original exit101 is retained.

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: membership_feed
functions.source:
with candidates as materialized (
    select m.* from public.feed_memberships own cross join lateral (
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is null and group_key = own.group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
      union all
      (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
        where p_c is not null and group_key = own.group_key
          and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
        order by at desc, message_key desc limit 21)
    ) m where own.member_id = (select auth.uid())
    order by m.at desc, m.message_key desc limit 21
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 20), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 20 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 20) else null end)
    from ranked;

functions.name: membership_thread
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_thread(p_group_key text, p_c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.feed_memberships where group_key = p_group_key and member_id = (select auth.uid()))
    then raise exception 'MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED'; end if;
  with candidates as materialized (
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is null and group_key = p_group_key order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
    union all
    (select message_key, group_key, at, body from public.feed_messages
      where p_c is not null and group_key = p_group_key
        and (at, message_key) < ((p_c->>'at')::bigint, (p_c->>'messageKey') collate "C")
      order by at desc, message_key desc limit 51)
  ), ranked as (select *, row_number() over (order by at desc, message_key desc) n from candidates)
  select jsonb_build_object('data', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('messageKey', message_key, 'groupKey', group_key, 'at', at, 'body', body)
    order by at desc, message_key desc) filter (where n <= 50), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next', case when count(*) > 50 then (select jsonb_build_object('at', at, 'messageKey', message_key) from ranked where n = 50) else null end)
    into result from ranked;
  return result;
end;
$function$
